sources.title: Maestri
sources.finding: Mac native Swift/AppKit, Linux/Windows Electron UI around shared native Swift engine. Free one workspace/unlimited agents; Pro18USD one-time2devices/unlimitedworkspaces,7daytrial; Teams up to100seats. Models separate.

sources.title: Maestri terms
sources.finding: Free all features one workspace; Pro personal two devices; Teams purchasing organization one device per seat. One-time payment; proprietary software, not source license.

sources.title: Maestri privacy
sources.finding: Local workspace/notes/preferences; separate CLI provider traffic. License email/key/deviceID/name; automatic update platform/arch/version may be disabled. Optional encrypted notification relay with push tokens; Cloudflare/Stripe/Apple/Google roles, request deletion by email.

sources.title: Maestri docs/environments
sources.finding: Local/Localtmux,WindowsWSL,SSH,Dockerexec,DockerSandbox,Maccustomruntimes. Existing host/container required, no managed cloud provision. Context,skills,CLI,roles,uploads and floors follow environment; persistent tmux reattaches.

sources.title: Maestri docs/notes
sources.locator: Markdown files; lock; custom location; removal
sources.finding: Human and agent editable Markdown notes, chained connected context, images and Mermaid. Content lock blocks agent writes. Custom-file removal keeps original; default note file deleted with canvas node.

sources.title: Maestri docs/maestro
sources.finding: Maestro agents recruit mixed configured CLI presets, assign/update roles, connect notes, check/ask/dismiss; normal agents cannot provision workspaces/floors. Reassignment restarts agent process while preserving canvas and connections.

sources.title: Maestri docs/bands
sources.finding: Band groups running terminal identities without restarting; Maestro pinned; shared band wiring reaches members. Dissolve restores terminals; band is not a task dependency system.

sources.title: Maestri docs/partituras
sources.finding: JSON ensemble templates carry roles, notes, layout/connections; strip runtime/scrollback/absolute paths/environment configs. Import reviews command risk; globals/workspace scopes; crosscomputer copies are independent, not live sync.

sources.title: Maestri docs/chat
sources.finding: Seven stable-color subjects per terminal, locked during turn; app-owned transcript survives CLI replacement and attachment files persist. Clearing removes app history/files, not provider memory; phone sees same host threads.

sources.title: Maestri docs/floors
sources.finding: Floors defaultGitworktrees; optional local independentcopy onCoW disk. CoW copies dependencies/env/dirtyedits but excludes buildcaches; Windows/nonCoW plain checkout. gh/glab PR create/list/merge/checks; fork review read-only branch. Merge refuses dirty/conflicting state; no mandatory test/spec gates stated.

sources.title: Maestri docs/wire
sources.finding: OptionalHTTPS/WSS serverdefault7434, pinnedselfsignedkey,5minsingleusepaircode orpassword,bearertoken hash,30dayidleexpiry. Fullcontrol/read-onlydevice roles, guests readall but no writes. Presence, sharedcanvas/terminals, revisionguardednotes, mobile and pairedcomputer clients. Beta contract.

sources.title: Maestri docs/computer-use
sources.locator: Permissions; revocation; control mode; OS differences
sources.finding: Opt-in app use with peragent/app allow-untilquit or1hour, deny-currentprocess, stop/revoke; Maestri itself excluded. Separate exclusivewholecomputercontrol pauseshumaninput,esc3stop. Bypasspermissions optional; LinuxWayland limitations distinct.

sources.title: Maestri docs/routines
sources.finding: Local schedules send prompts to terminal or reminder, recurring/once/calendar/interval; optional pre-run condition and busy skip. App/host must be available; no managedscheduler promise.

sources.title: maestri wire/client.ts
sources.finding: Demo client pairs with code/password, sends bearer tokens over HTTPS and token in WSS URL; actual transport disables certificate validation while a separate certificate pin probe is advisory and not bound to the request channel.

sources.title: maestri wire/pairing-store.ts
sources.finding: Paired device token and host metadata are local JSON with file mode0600; clear removes local file. This does not establish desktop server token storage or revocation enforcement.

sources.title: maestri server.ts
sources.finding: Default bind127.0.0.1, HOST override; IP/localhost/.local Host allowlist and JSON content-type checks. No per-browser login in demo; optional LAN exposure permits reachable users to use paired controls. Unpair attempts server revoke then clears local state even when revoke fails.
